title: Little Bit of Heaven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and two coffee makers (large pot and Keurig) invites you to craft culinary delights, while the adjacent dining area offers a cozy setting for meals. The additional bedrooms provide plush king beds and 56" TVs, ensuring comfort and entertainment for all guests. Kids will adore the unique bunk room with a twin/full/twin trundle, a 43" TV, and two gaming chairs. The outdoor shower, full-size Connect Four game, and ample parking for two cars plus a golf cart add to the convenience and charm of this exceptional home. With complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and a full-size washer/dryer, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to ensure a luxurious and unforgettable beachside escape for up to fourteen guests. A four-bedroom gem perfect for families and pet lovers alike. Located on the beach side of 30A, directly across from the pool, this spacious retreat includes a complimentary golf cart for easy exploration of the picturesque surroundings. The home boasts two main bedrooms, one conveniently located on the main level and the other upstairs, each featuring a king bed, a 56" TV, and an en suite bathroom. Step out onto the charming balcony accessible from two of the bedrooms, or unwind on the front and back porches adorned with enchanting string lights and a swinging daybed. The expansive living area is the heart of the home, equipped with a 75" Smart TV and ample seating, making it the perfect spot for family gatherings.
